heroSubtitle: Import sheet music images, review the result, and edit, practice or share your scores.
featuresDesc: Review imported notation, save revisions and control access to your scores.
feature1Desc: Submit sheet music images for recognition, then review the resulting notation before creating a score.
feature2Desc: Practice a score step by step or in continuous play mode.
feature3Desc: Edit notes, rhythms and score details, then save a new revision.
feature4Desc: Invite collaborators to view, practice or edit. Share a Guest Preview link for viewing and listening.
howItWorksSubtitle: From uploaded images to a score you can review and use.
step1Desc: Drag and drop or select your sheet music image files. Supports multiple uploads at once.
step2Desc: Inspect the recognized notation and make corrections in Review before confirming your score.
step3Desc: Listen, practice and share your score. Owners can download MusicXML and rendered score pages.
ctaTitle: Ready to start your musical journey?
